title: docs(rest,spec): metadata.endpoints.item says thirteen mounts, names history methods (#29035)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TBoN64CQFXszsEspiHHghp)_

Fixes #29035

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 业务影响：无行为变化，只改注释、describe 文案和一条台账说明。
- 背景：#27627 把应用元数据 bundle 接入 per-item 开关后，`metadata.endpoints.item` 实际管 13 个挂载点，多处注释仍写“12”。
- 改了什么：rest-server 注释、挂载表 pin 测试头注释、liveness 台账 note 均改为 13；路由台账注明当前 9 次 `registerPerItemRoute(` 调用。
- 规格文案：spec describe 写明历史族方法（GET 读，POST publish/rollback），与 pin 测试拼写一致。
- 生成物：重新生成 `content/docs/references/api/rest-server.mdx`；附 `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset。
- 风险：极低；路由、成员、默认值、接受集合均未变。

## Card items
1. `registerPerItemRoute` docblock (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`): thirteen mounts, bundle named, nine calls in three modules.
2. `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` header: THIRTEEN (assertions untouched — no forced test edit).
3. `packages/spec/liveness/metadata_endpoints.json` `item` note: thirteen.
4. `rest-route-ledger.ts` ~L114: measured 9 `registerPerItemRoute(` calls (1 bundle + 2 writes + 6 history); original 80/51/29 reading left as recorded history.
5. `rest-server.zod.ts` describe: `GET` `/history`, `/audit`, `/diff`, `/published`; `POST` `/publish`, `/rollback`.

Generated: `content/docs/references/api/rest-server.mdx` (gen:docs). gen:schema / gen:openapi moved nothing.

## Verification
- rest mount-table pin 24/24, rest-route-ledger conformance 7/7, spec liveness 12 files / 359 tests green.
- dispatch-gates: 107 derived, 107 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED; `pnpm lint` exit 0.
- No negative pin added → no ablation owed.
